title: Naturalistic Polar Bear
description: Polar bear but in the naturalist mod style.
body:
Polar bears remodelled and retextured to fit the style of the [Naturalist mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/naturalist).

Requires [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures),
(or optifine if you're weird).

![Polar Bear & Naturalist Bear Side By Side](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dda750651a06e8ebc1897a9a1bd56469380a59d7.png)
